title: Nasa moon rocket creeps to its launch pad in preparation for astronaut flight
summary: First journey around moon with astronauts in more than 50 years could blast off in February Nasa’s giant new moon rocket has moved to the launch pad in preparation for astronauts’ first lunar fly-around in more than half a century. The trip could blast off in February. Continue reading...

title: Thousands march in Greenland against Trump’s threats to take it over
summary: Greenlanders march in Nuuk opposing Trump’s plan to control the Arctic island and impose tariffs on Europe.

title: Turkiye’s Sonmez aids ball girl, enters Australian Open second round
summary: Zeynep Sonmez runs and helps a fainting ball girl by guiding her to a seat during her shock win in the first round.
